name: ZEN.COM Smart Business

faq.question: Does the ZEN.COM Smart Business charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the ZEN.COM Smart Business?
faq.answer: It charges about 0.5% on non-base-currency spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the ZEN.COM Smart Business require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
